newsitem.title: NORWAY: Barents Sea exploration spud postponed - Statoil.
newsitem.headline: Barents Sea exploration spud postponed - Statoil.

text.p: Spudding of an exploration well in the Barents Sea has been postponed for a couple of months due to delays with the Transocean Arctic rig, operator Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday.
Well 7228/7-1S, which lies in the North Cape Basin, originally was due to be drilled in December, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.
The well forms part of production licence 202, which was awarded in September 1993 with a commitment to drill two wells under Norway's 14th offshore licensing round.
Statoil said the well would test a new geological exploration model following extensive seismic surveys in the area.
